title: Critical Bug Lifecycle
scenario: Compare the duration of the first status change to the duration of the last status change for 'Critical' bugs.
tableSchema: bugs (bug_id INT, severity VARCHAR), status_history (bug_id INT, changed_at TIMESTAMP)
correctQuery: SELECT bug_id, (last_dur - first_dur) FROM (SELECT bug_id, MIN(duration) FILTER (WHERE rnk=1) as first_dur, MAX(duration) FILTER (WHERE rnk_desc=1) as last_dur FROM (SELECT bug_id, changed_at - LAG(changed_at) OVER(PARTITION BY bug_id ORDER BY changed_at) as duration, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY bug_id ORDER BY changed_at) as rnk, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY bug_id ORDER BY changed_at DESC) as rnk_desc FROM status_history) t GROUP BY bug_id) t2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE bugs (bug_id INT, severity VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE status_history (bug_id INT, changed_at TIMESTAMP);
